data.narrative:
UFORCE is a seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Oleg Rogynskyy (CEO) and Oleksiy Honcharuk (co-founder, board chair, ex-PM of Ukraine). The company has raised $50M to date. The peer universe comprises 10 comparables: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

Valuation analysis applied one reliable method: Peer-Median, using three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables. Stark Defence ($4.0B Series A), Singularity ($400M Series A), and NODA AI ($125M Series A) yielded a median of $400M with a range of $125M to $4.0B. Stage-Progression was not applied; the stated $1B+ post-money valuation implies a 20x multiple on capital raised, suggesting a data-integrity issue with that input.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $340M to $460M, with a median of $400M. This implies a 6.8x return multiple on the $50M raised. Key uncertainties include the wide dispersion among peer valuations ($125M to $4.0B), reflecting heterogeneity in Defense & Security funding stages and technology maturity, and the limited sample size of three comparable transactions. Additional visibility into UFORCE's revenue, customer concentration, and technical differentiation would refine this estimate.
